mapper.select: SELECT SUM(psid.stock_in_qty) stockInQty FROM po_instock_detail psid LEFT JOIN po_instock psi ON psid.main_id = psi.id AND psid.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE psi.approve_status = 'approve' AND psi..is_deleted = FALSE AND psi.invalid_status = FALSE AND psid.purchase_order_detail_id = #{purchaseOrderDetailId}

select psi.approve_status, psid.main_id, psid.sku_id, psid.sku_no, psid.variant_property, psid.stock_in_qty, psid.purchase_qty, psid.receive_qty, psid.exceed_qty, psid.warehouse_location, psid.remark, psid.source_detail_id, psid.purchase_order_detail_id from po_instock psi inner join po_instock_detail psid on psi.id = psid.main_id and psid.is_deleted = false
psi.is_deleted = false and psi.invalid_status = false
and psid.source_detail_id in
#{item}
